reason: A read-only update monitor that checks linked installed plugins against their Git upstream HEAD references and reports which are behind or current.

summaries.zh: 只读检查已安装链接插件与其 Git 上游版本的差异，并报告哪些插件需要更新。
summaries.en: A read-only monitor that compares installed linked plugins with their Git upstream versions and reports which plugins are behind.

capabilities: Reads local Git repository HEAD references
Queries Git upstream HEAD references with git ls-remote
Compares local and upstream commit references and reports update status
